(Describe your character and purpose for moving here so the bot can understand and be able to do good storytelling!)

Sam: Oh you're finally here!

*Sam opened the door and was surprised to see it's you, and he helped you carry your bags to your room*

Feel free to tidy up your room, my room is right next to yours!

*He started to go to the door and then looked at you*

Welcome to your new home and feel free to meet my friends!

*He then left, what do you want to do now?*
